cond_0001.intro: The candidate will be coordinating clinical research protocols from study start up to close out. This candidate will work closely with all research staff to collect, store and maintain data in accordance with FDA Regulations, International Council of Harmonization and Good Clinical Practices.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
May be the sole coordinator or work in collaboration with a research nurse on studies, responsible for source documents, data collection, data entry, query resolution, triggering financial payments, study close out and liaison with the sponsor/CRO
Participates in the identification of potential clinical trial participants, screens them for eligibility, and enrolls participants per protocol
Coordinates the schedule of events for clinical trial participants from screening to follow up according to protocol
Collects, verifies, organizes and records clinical information and data in electronic data capture systems (EDC). Abstracts data from necessary sources to complete the EDC and resolve queries. Performs the following data related activities: EDC tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation and safety coding
May be responsible for regulatory submissions. Need working knowledge of essential documents and IRB requirements
Participates in site feasibility determination, site qualification visits, site initiation visits and research related meetings
May be responsible for recruiting clinical trials to site
May have patient contact
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
1 Year of CRC experience
Preferred Requirements
1 Year of oncology or cardio experience

cond_0062.responsibilities:
Own coordination of studies as the sole coordinator or alongside a research nurse — accountable for source documents, data collection, data entry, query resolution, triggering financial payments, study close-out, and liaison with the sponsor/CRO
Lead identification of potential clinical trial participants, screen them for eligibility, and execute enrollment per protocol
Direct the schedule of events for clinical trial participants from screening to follow-up according to protocol
Collect, verify, organize, and record clinical information and data in electronic data capture systems (EDC). Abstract data from necessary sources to complete the EDC and resolve queries. Execute the following data-related activities: EDC tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation, and safety coding
Manage regulatory submissions as needed. Maintain working knowledge of essential documents and IRB requirements
Drive site feasibility determination, site qualification visits, site initiation visits, and research-related meetings
Lead recruiting of clinical trials to site as needed
May have patient contact
cond_0062.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
1 Year of CRC experience
1 Year of oncology or cardiology experience
cond_0062.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

May be responsible for recruiting clinical trials to site
May have direct patient contact

cond_0220.intro: The candidate will be coordinating clinical research protocols from study start up to close out. This candidate will work closely with all research staff to collect, store and maintain data in accordance with FDA Regulations, International Council of Harmonization and Good Clinical Practices. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of regulatory and data requirements the work involves.
cond_0220.responsibilities:
May be the sole coordinator or work in collaboration with a research nurse on studies, responsible for source documents, data collection, data entry, query resolution, triggering financial payments, study close out and liaison with the sponsor/CRO
Participates in the identification of potential clinical trial participants, screens them for eligibility, and enrolls participants per protocol
Coordinates the schedule of events for clinical trial participants from screening to follow up according to protocol
Collects, verifies, organizes and records clinical information and data in electronic data capture systems (EDC). Abstracts data from necessary sources to complete the EDC and resolve queries. Performs the following data related activities: EDC tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation and safety coding
May be responsible for regulatory submissions. Need working knowledge of essential documents and IRB requirements
Participates in site feasibility determination, site qualification visits, site initiation visits and research related meetings
May be responsible for recruiting clinical trials to site
May have patient contact
cond_0220.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
1 Year of CRC experience
Preferred Requirements
1 Year of oncology or cardio experience

cond_0252.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Research Coordinator to join our team. The role involves coordinating clinical research protocols from study start up to close out, working closely with all research staff to collect, store, and maintain data in accordance with FDA Regulations, International Council of Harmonization, and Good Clinical Practices.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
May work as the sole coordinator or alongside a research nurse on studies, sharing responsibility for source documents, data collection, data entry, query resolution, triggering financial payments, study close out, and liaison with the sponsor/CRO
Participates with the team in identifying potential clinical trial participants, screens them for eligibility, and enrolls participants per protocol
Coordinates the schedule of events for clinical trial participants from screening to follow up according to protocol
Works with research staff to collect, verify, organize, and record clinical information and data in electronic data capture systems (EDC). Abstracts data from necessary sources to complete the EDC and resolve queries. Supports the following data related activities: EDC tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation, and safety coding
May share responsibility for regulatory submissions. Requires working knowledge of essential documents and IRB requirements
Participates in site feasibility determination, site qualification visits, site initiation visits, and research related meetings
May support recruiting clinical trials to site
May have patient contact
cond_0252.requirements:
1 Year of CRC Experience
1 Year of Oncology or Cardio Experience

This role involves leading clinical research protocols from study start-up to close-out, working closely with research staff to collect, store, and maintain data in accordance with FDA Regulations, International Council of Harmonization, and Good Clinical Practices.
cond_0332.responsibilities:
Own coordination of studies as the sole coordinator or alongside a research nurse — accountable for source documents, data collection, data entry, query resolution, triggering financial payments, study close-out, and liaison with the sponsor/CRO
Lead identification of potential clinical trial participants, screen them for eligibility, and execute enrollment per protocol
Direct the schedule of events for clinical trial participants from screening to follow-up according to protocol
Collect, verify, organize, and record clinical information and data in electronic data capture systems (EDC). Abstract data from necessary sources to complete the EDC and resolve queries. Execute the following data-related activities: EDC tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation, and safety coding
Manage regulatory submissions as needed. Maintain working knowledge of essential documents and IRB requirements
Drive site feasibility determination, site qualification visits, site initiation visits, and research-related meetings
Lead recruiting of clinical trials to site as needed
May have patient contact
cond_0332.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
1 Year of CRC experience
1 Year of oncology or cardiology experience

cond_0522.responsibilities:
May work as the sole coordinator or alongside a research nurse on studies, sharing responsibility for source documents, data collection, data entry, query resolution, triggering financial payments, study close out, and liaison with the sponsor/CRO
Participates with the team in identifying potential clinical trial participants, screens them for eligibility, and enrolls participants per protocol
Coordinates the schedule of events for clinical trial participants from screening to follow up according to protocol
Works with research staff to collect, verify, organize, and record clinical information and data in electronic data capture systems (EDC). Abstracts data from necessary sources to complete the EDC and resolve queries. Supports the following data related activities: EDC tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation, and safety coding
May share responsibility for regulatory submissions. Requires working knowledge of essential documents and IRB requirements
Participates in site feasibility determination, site qualification visits, site initiation visits, and research related meetings
May support recruiting clinical trials to site
May have patient contact
cond_0522.requirements:
1 Year of CRC Experience
1 Year of Oncology or Cardio Experience
cond_0522.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0522.workplace_support: Our workplace is designed to support different ways of working and different stages of life and career. We provide flexibility so employees can do their best work while balancing collaboration, wellbeing, and personal responsibilities.
